name: Assembly
description: Assembly language provides direct control over CPU instructions, memory, and registers. Essential for understanding computer architecture, reverse engineering, embedded systems, and performance-critical code optimization.

items.title: Programming from the Ground Up
items.description: Classic textbook teaching core programming concepts using x86 assembly and GNU/Linux.

items.title: PC Assembly Language (Paul Carter)
items.description: Widely recommended intro covering x86 assembly, data representation, memory layout, and C interop.

items.title: Intel SDM Manuals
items.description: Official Intel software developer manuals for IA-32 and x86-64 architecture.

items.title: ARM Architecture Reference
items.description: Official ARM architectural specifications covering instruction sets and features.

items.title: Compiler Explorer (Godbolt)
items.description: Write C/C++/Rust and see the generated assembly output instantly — essential for learning how compilers translate code.

items.title: Azeria Labs ARM Assembly
items.description: Acclaimed text-based course on ARM 32-bit assembly for security research and exploit development.

items.title: ARM Assembly Course (freeCodeCamp)
items.description: Practical video covering ARMv7 architecture, registers, instructions, and Linux syscalls.

items.title: Modern x64 Assembly (Creel)
items.description: Video series on modern x64 assembly, hardware interactions, and performance optimization.

items.title: Compiler Explorer (Godbolt)
items.description: Best tool for practicing assembly — compare your output with compiler-generated code.

items.title: TIS-100 (Programming Game)
items.description: Retro puzzle game requiring custom assembly code to solve spatial and arithmetic problems.

items.title: X86 Instruction Reference
items.description: Searchable web reference for x86/x64 instructions, flags, and opcodes.

items.title: Devhints Assembly Reference
items.description: Quick reference for common assembly instructions and registers.

items.title: Intel Developer Zone
items.description: Intel developer news on architecture updates and instruction set extensions.

items.title: Reddit r/Assembly_language
items.description: Community for assembly news, questions, and low-level discussions.

items.title: Reddit r/Assembly_language
items.description: Dedicated community for assembly language questions and code discussions.

items.title: Stack Overflow — Assembly Tag
items.description: Q&A for assembly syntax, debugging, and low-level code optimization.

lessons.title: Fundamentals of Assembly
lessons.description: Core concepts, syntax, and first steps with Assembly
